senses.gloss: c. (= b. h. אוֹת; fr. תאה, or תאו, sec. r. of אה or או; as to reject. of radical ו or ה, cmp. אב, אח &c.) sign, type; letter (v. אוֹת II).
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 13:16">Targ. Ex. XIII, 16</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 7:11">Targ. Is. VII, 11</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>אָתִין</he>, <he>אָתַיָּא</he>.

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 74:4">Targ. Ps. LXXIV, 4</cite>; a. e.—<he>אַתְוָון</he>, <he>אַתְיָין</he>, <cite ref="A01808"><he>אַתְוָותָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="A03404"><he>אַתְוָאן</he></cite>, (<cite ref="A03429"><he>אָתָן</he></cite>) <he>אַתְיָיתָא</he>. Targ. Ps. l. c.
<cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 2:2">Targ. O. Num. II, 2</cite> ed. Berl. <he>אַתְיַן</he>, Var. <he>אָתְיָן</he>, <he>אַתְוָון</he>; Y. <he>אתוון</he> (v. Berl. Targ. O. II, p. 39); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:13:1">Koh. R. to I, 13</cite> <he>ה׳ אתואן</he> five letters of acrostics.—<he>אַתְוָיֵי</he> (<he>אַתְוֵוי</he>, <he>אִיתְוֵי</he>).
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 13:16">Num. R. s. 13</cite>, end <he>א׳ דידין וכ׳</he> the letters composing the one word (<he>קערת</he>) are the same as those composing the other (<he>קרעת</he>).
